predecessors.name: Sui dynasty
predecessors.text: Dongping (modern Heze) and Yan Prefecture (modern Jining), the core of Xu's Lu in western Shandong

successors.name: Tang dynasty
successors.text: Dongping (modern Heze), Yan Prefecture (modern Jining) and Langye (modern Linyi): the three places the Xu Yuanlang page names in Shandong

rulers.name: Xu Yuanlang
rulers.title: Duke of Lu (nominal, from Tang in 621 and earlier); Prince of Lu from winter 621

ledger.x: 617: Xu Yuanlang rises against the Sui.
621: Xu Yuanlang declares himself Prince of Lu.
623: the contest ends with the siege of Yan.
623: Xu Yuanlang is killed and Tang takes the territory.

wars.name: Tang campaigns against Xu Yuanlang
wars.outcome: Tang victory: after Liu Heita's defeat in summer 622, Li Shentong, Li Shiji and Ren Gui attacked Xu's lands; the siege of Yan in spring 623 broke his army and he was killed on 26 March 623.

certainty.note: Rebel zone with no frontier on the page; three Shandong places are circles, not a boundary.
